The QA PR line in Nos and the absence of a twin cannot be asserted or configured with the available setup recipes.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event carries the round.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the event carries the round.
